schedule_policy: sort all 32x4 task/model units by SHA256(seed|group/task|model); method order via matched_dev.pair_order
freeze_policy: Before ANY Main pair, pin the controller Git SHA, main plan file SHA, taskset file SHA, model config SHA, readiness/evidence SHA, upstream Git SHA, and exact installed digest of ALL FOUR configured model checkpoints inside the immutable manifest; reject missing/drifted checkpoint and never retry or selectively replace an arm
paired_validity_rule: Two completed valid official main episodes, equal initial SHA, expected task/group/phase/controller/model digest, distinct owned databases, frozen order and protocol, official reward consistent with success; otherwise exclude both arms from paired success denominator.
invalid_episode_rule: Keep invalid or unsealed attempts as invalid with raw records; never impute fail or automatically rerun; preserve missing and infrastructure errors separately.

analysis.primary_estimand: Proposed minus Baseline official task success fraction, among valid matched bank-information task-model pairs
analysis.primary_statistic: (Proposed-only successes - Baseline-only successes) / valid paired bank task-model units
analysis.analysis_unit: one paired task ID x model checkpoint; units share app/account/templates and are not fully independent
analysis.inference: two-sided exact McNemar p is exploratory, unadjusted, and not cluster robust; with only five bank task IDs, do not claim conclusive superiority from p < 0.05 alone
primary_reporting: valid, invalid and unstarted among 20 planned bank pairs
paired outcome table (both success; Proposed-only; Baseline-only; neither)
exact two-sided McNemar exploratory sensitivity (only after full main schedule attempted)
breakdown by bank task ID and model
observed comparable public information-probe decisions and treatment action divergences
secondary_reporting: pair coverage by model and cohort
steps/time on valid successful episodes only
probe opportunities, comparable decisions and policy divergences
decision_rules: Zero comparable probes/divergences means treatment not engaged; no CDEA mechanism-effect conclusion.
Missing or invalid pairs must never be counted as official failures or silently dropped from coverage.
Do not use main outcomes to alter task roster, model, budget, method or analyze only favorable subsets.
No unqualified population-level claims from repeated tasks/models on shared OpenApps seed state.
